name: Piecewise-Projective Contraction
definition: A contraction function that maps unbounded space into a finite domain while preserving straight lines (piecewise-linear), allowing for efficient ray-AABB intersection tests for empty space skipping. It consists of seven regions (unit cube + 6 outer regions).
summary: Piecewise-projective contraction maps unbounded 3D space to a bounded volume while preserving straight lines, enabling efficient empty space skipping via ray-AABB intersection tests in voxel-based volume rendering.
